scripts.setup: npm run setup:env && npm run setup:permissions
scripts.setup:env: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (!fs.existsSync('.env')) { fs.copyFileSync('.env.example', '.env'); console.log('✅ Fichier .env créé'); } else { console.log('⚠️  .env existe déjà'); }"
scripts.docker:up: cd docker && docker-compose up -d && npm run docker:info
scripts.docker:up-basic: cd docker && docker-compose up -d app ollama chroma redis
scripts.docker:info:
node -e "console.log('
✅ Services démarrés!

📍 Services disponibles:
  • API NestJS:      http://localhost:3001
  • Ollama Web UI:   http://localhost:8081
  • ChromaDB:        http://localhost:8000
  • Qdrant:          http://localhost:6333/dashboard
  • SearXNG:         http://localhost:8888
')"
scripts.ollama:list: cd docker && docker-compose exec ollama ollama list
scripts.ollama:pull-llama: cd docker && docker-compose exec ollama ollama pull llama3.2
scripts.ollama:pull-embeddings: cd docker && docker-compose exec ollama ollama pull nomic-embed-text
scripts.ollama:shell: cd docker && docker-compose exec ollama bash
scripts.ollama:test: cd docker && docker-compose exec ollama ollama run llama3.2 "Quelle est la capitale de la France? Réponds en une phrase."
scripts.shell: cd docker && docker-compose exec app sh
scripts.shell:postgres: cd docker && docker-compose exec postgres psql -U raguser -d ragdb
scripts.shell:redis: cd docker && docker-compose exec redis redis-cli
scripts.test: cd docker && docker-compose exec app npm test
scripts.test:e2e: cd docker && docker-compose exec app npm run test:e2e
scripts.test:cov: cd docker && docker-compose exec app npm run test:cov
scripts.test:watch: cd docker && docker-compose exec app npm run test:watch
scripts.clean:all: cd docker && docker-compose down -v && docker system prune -a -f && docker volume prune -f
scripts.install:docker: cd docker && docker-compose exec app npm install
scripts.lint: cd docker && docker-compose exec app npm run lint
scripts.format: cd docker && docker-compose exec app npm run format
scripts.dev:docker:shell: docker compose -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec app sh
scripts.info: npm run info:docker && npm run info:volumes
scripts.info:docker: node -e "console.log('Docker:'); const { execSync } = require('child_process'); try { console.log(execSync('docker --version').toString()); console.log(execSync('docker-compose --version').toString()); } catch(e) { console.log('❌ Docker non installé'); }"
scripts.info:volumes: docker volume ls | grep rag || echo "Aucun volume"
scripts.urls:
node -e "console.log('🌐 URLs des services:✅ Interface utilisateur:
  • API NestJS:      http://localhost:3001
  • API Docs:        http://localhost:3001/api/docs
  • Ollama Web UI:   http://localhost:8080
  • SearXNG:         http://localhost:8888

✅ Bases de données:
  • ChromaDB:        http://localhost:8000
  • Qdrant:          http://localhost:6333/dashboard
  • Redis:           localhost:6379
  • PostgreSQL:      localhost:5432
')"
